en: Oh! Hi! You're not a ROCKET!\nYou came to save us?\lWhy, thank you!\pI want you to have this POKéMON\nfor saving us.
{PLAYER} obtained a LAPRAS from\nthe SILPH employee!

It's a LAPRAS.
It's a very intelligent POKéMON.\pWe kept it in our lab, but it will
be much better off with you.\pI think you will be a good TRAINER
for LAPRAS!\pIt's a good swimmer.
It'll give you a lift across water!
TEAM ROCKET's BOSS went to the\nboardroom!\pIs our PRESIDENT okay?\nI'm worried.
TEAM ROCKET was after the MASTER\nBALL, which catches any POKéMON.
We canceled the MASTER BALL\nproject because of TEAM ROCKET.
It would be bad if TEAM ROCKET\ntook over SILPH or our POKéMON.
Wow!\pYou chased off TEAM ROCKET all by\nyourself?
You!\nIt's really dangerous here!\pYou came to save me?\nYou can't!
Thank you so much!
Uh-oh!\nI smell a little mouse!
Lights out!
You won't find my BOSS by just\nscurrying around!
Heheh!\pYou mistook me for a SILPH worker?
I'm done!
Despite your age, you are a\nskilled TRAINER!
I am one of the four ROCKET\nBROTHERS!
Aack!\nBrothers, I lost!
Doesn't matter.\nMy brothers will repay the favor!
A child intruder?\nThat must be you!
Fine!\nI lost!
Go on home before my BOSS gets\nticked off!
{RIVAL}: What kept you, {PLAYER}?

{RIVAL}: Hahaha! I thought you'd
turn up if I waited here!\pI guess TEAM ROCKET slowed you
down! Not that I care!\pI saw you in SAFFRON, so I decided
to see if you got better!
Oh, man!\nSo, you are ready for BOSS\lROCKET!

Well, {PLAYER}!
I'm moving on up and ahead!\pBy checking my POKéDEX, I'm
starting to see what's strong and\lhow they evolve!\pAm I a genius or what?\pI'm going to the POKéMON LEAGUE to
boot out the ELITE FOUR.\pI'll become the world's most
powerful TRAINER!\p{PLAYER}, well, good luck to you!
Don't sweat it!\lSmell ya!
SILPH CO. HEAD OFFICE\n7F
